overview: World-renowned paranormal investigator Jason Hawes uncovers the world's most horrifying haunts; he reveals the gravest of locations through spine-chilling firsthand accounts, eerie reenactments and eye-opening interviews with locals and historians.
title: Most Terrifying with Jason Hawes

overview: MTV's "House of Food" is a drama-infused take on food TV where a group of young aspiring chefs with no formal culinary training are put to the ultimate challenge. "House of Food" is a one hour, weekly docu-series that combines the exciting real-life competitive elements of culinary school, with the dramatic setting of a house reality show. The students have been chosen for their passion for cooking and food culture, and their backgrounds are as varied as their personalities. With three of the country's best chefs as their teachers and the city of Los Angeles as their classroom, this determined group will live and learn together but only one will win an apprenticeship of a lifetime.
title: House of Food

overview: A generation ago, Jacques-Yves Cousteau revealed the oceans' mysteries to millions of landlocked PBS television viewers, and inspired a groundswell of public awareness of the unique problems faced by the world's marine environments. Now, 30 years later, Jacques' son Jean-Michel Cousteau and his expedition team have set sail to explore dangerous and spectacular locales across the globe in the high-definition series, Jean-Michel Cousteau: Ocean Adventures, premiering with the film Voyage to Kure, narrated by Pierce Brosnan.
title: Ocean Adventures

overview: Celeb Ex in the City sees celebrities head off on a blind date, unaware that the Tablet of Terror has an EX-tra surprise in store...
title: Celeb Ex in the City

overview: Damian, 38, is an overseas Taiwanese, divorced his wife and returned to Taiwan to open his restaurant, Verso. While at Verso, he meets Jerry. Their relationship intensifies and Damian yearns to start a family, with Jerry reluctant to take on parental duties at such an early age. Four years later and through surrogacy, they are now gay parents to a four-year-old boy. Jerry still has not come out to his parents and has now become a fulltime dad even though his parents still pressure him to marry a woman. Damian is busier than ever at Verso and their son Kai is just getting ready for pre-school....
title: Papa and Daddy

overview: When darkness get strengthened to destroy the world, Suryanshis chose Shaktimaan in order to fight against the forces of evil.
title: Shaktimaan

overview: The singing sisters return to dry land after their incredible trip. Coleen, Linda, Maureen and Anne share more glamorous, revelatory and moving moments.
title: At Home with the Nolans

overview: Welcome to the W.I.O.U. guide at TV Tome. Show Type: Drama First Telecast: October 24, 1990 Last Telecast: March 20, 1991 Hank Zaret was the new news director at TV station WNDY, sent by executives at the network which owned the station to boost its falling ratings. Hank, who had gotten his start there years before, returned to a station in such financial trouble, its staff had nicknamed it WIOU. The main WNDY on-camera news personnel were: anchor Neal Frazier, an overbearing womainzer with an inflated ego and a wandering eye; co-anchor Kelby Robinson, a dedicated journalist who had once been Hank's lover; weatherman Floyd Graham, a lovable veteran who was going blind from glaucoma; Eddie Bock, an ambitious reporter / newsman who had minimal scrupples when it came to furthering his career and reporter Taylor Young, a recent arrival from Tampa with a mind-set identical to Eddie's. Others on the news staff were: longtime executive producer, Liz McVay, who fe
title: W.I.O.U.

overview: Jiang Cheng is an exemplary youth who excels in his studies. He was adopted since young, but was abandoned by his foster family and moved back with his father. Faced with an unfamiliar surrounding and a gambler father, he develops a rebellious character. His life took a change when he meets Gu Fei, a roguish and tough guy. As they get to know each other, they develop a close friendship and thus begin a journey of redemption as they help each other heal and grow through their pains.
title: Chasing the Light

overview: Som lost his daughter whose music is now his only resort. But, what if they lead to a cacophony of mysterious strains? Presenting hoichoi's first musical-thriller!
title: Shei Je Holud Pakhi

overview: An explosive combination of grey characters, edgy situations and lots and lots of emotional atyaachaar! Voot Originals present Shortcuts, a hand-picked selection of 12 twisted and thrilling short films.
title: Shortcuts

overview: Chechnyan War veteran Alexei Volkovoy (aka Volk) is a brutal gangster in Russia's underworld as well as a covert agent for the Russian military. Think of him as the Russian Jason Bourne.
title: Волк

overview: Since the death of his son murdered by accident by thugs, Daniel Munoz, a former thug, has decided to take the law into his own hands. He refuses the help of his brother Thomas, an arms dealer. Gaetan Veron, a criminal police officer, careerist and unscrupulous, convinces Thomas to reveal to him the place of Daniel's next action. Thomas, unaware of his younger brother's turnaround, finds himself face-to-face with him.
title: À Jamais

overview: A quick-witted dramedy that reveals the explosive and hilarious journey of three African immigrants as they navigate the treacherous waters of social awkwardness, romance, challenging friendships, while yet maintaining their cultural pride.
title: Yankee Hustle

overview: The TV channel presents a new version of the musical project "You are a superstar!" - "Superstar!". Artists whose popularity peaked in the 80s–90s and 2000s are competing for the title of "superstar." Each episode of the program is dedicated to a specific topic, for example, "Hit with a star," "Your own hit," "Dedication to friends," etc.
title: Суперстар!

overview: A veteran fighter, who was absent in his son's life, is looking for the right one to continue his legend in the ring. Now, his son is his worst rival.
title: Por la Máscara

overview: This Portuguese comedy show is about the daily lifes of neighbours living at Campo de Ourique, with really confusing life stories.
title: Aqui Não Há Quem Viva

overview: Baby Daddy‘s Melissa Peterman hosts the game show that challenges parents to try to predict their child's next move in an effort to win money for their child's future education.
title: Bet on Your Baby

overview: God's Favorite Idiot follows Clark Thompson, a mid-level tech support employee who finds love with co-worker Amily Luck at exactly the same time he becomes the unwitting messenger of God. Also, there's rollerskating, a lake of fire and an impending apocalypse.
title: God's Favorite Idiot

overview: After podcast host, Artemis, and her twin brother, Paul, uncover a secret race of werewolves, they must decide who to trust and the price they're willing to pay for a juicy story.
title: Wayward Guide

overview: In Acapulco, a young Mexican man's dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at the hottest resort in Acapulco. But he soon realizes the job is far more complicated than he ever imagined as all of his beliefs and morals start to be questioned. The show takes place in 1984 with Eugenio Derbez narrating and playing the present-day version of the main character.
title: Acapulco

overview: Can I get an amen up in here? Reverend Silky Nutmeg Ganache is here to help us slay, shantay, and pray!
title: Shantay You Pray

overview: Pompam hosts an exciting competition where Tay, Namtan, Kay and Puimek compete in a race to answer trivia questions that sends them scrambling around Bangkok to earn fabulous prizes.
title: Kuad Wicha by Brand's Summer Camp

overview: Imagine a world where boys' love is normal. You don't have to prove yourself more just because you're gay or different. No judgy stares and harsh whispers from strangers or even from family. Our story is about the coming of age of two boys that are feeling alone and their adventures to find a place they can call home. Welcome to our world. Welcome to Your Home.
title: Your Home

overview: A series of five short films that celebrate America's National Parks and the incredible adventurers who explore them.
title: Great Wide Open

overview: Top Gear is a British television series about motor vehicles, primarily cars, and the most widely watched factual television programme in the world.
title: Top Gear

overview: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.
title: Legend of the Superstition Mountains

overview: Den osannolika mördaren is a fictional interpretation of how Stig Engström, the graphic designer who was named as the probable murderer of Sweden's prime minister Olof Palme, managed to elude justice right up to his death through a combination of audacity, luck and a perplexed police force. What do we know about Stig Engström? How could the police let him get away, despite being on his track? The murder was not planned well, Engström did everything wrong from the beginning and almost no one believed his lies about what he actually did during that fateful night 1986 in Stockholm, Sweden.
title: Den osannolika mördaren

overview: The Big Leap is a big-hearted, rowdy dramedy about a group of diverse, down-on-their-luck characters attempting to change their lives by participating in a potentially life-ruining reality dance show that builds to a live production of Swan Lake. What this group of underdogs lack in dance training, they make up for with their edge, wit and desire to reimagine an iconic story to fit their own mold.
title: The Big Leap

overview: Candy Montgomery is a 1980 housewife and mother who did everything right—good husband, two kids, nice house, even the careful planning and execution of transgressions—but when the pressure of conformity builds within her, her actions scream for just a bit of freedom. Until someone tells her to shush. With deadly results.
title: Candy

overview: From haunted houses to ghosts and zombies, here's a series of spine-chilling stories. Watch at your own risk!
title: Ssshhhh... Koi Hai

overview: SideHero is a fictionalised take on actor Kunaal Roy Kapur's life in Bollywood as a constantly neglected side-actor.
title: SideHero

overview: Six is a Bengali and Hindi web series streaming on Bengali OTT platform hoichoi. The series is about Soumyojit Ray who's life turns upside down, when his wife suddenly dies and he gets accused. This hoichoi original series starring Nishan Nanaiah, Darshana, and famous Bengali singer and lyricist Silajit Majumder in the lead roles. The series started streaming from 20th January 2018.
title: Six

overview: A comical look at the culture clash between two families, a Mexican one and a Spanish one, with very different ways and ideologies.
title: Herederos por accidente

overview: When a boy from the slum disappears, his search leads a historian and a journalist to strange and seemingly unrelated incidents, including warnings of natural calamities.
title: Skyfire

overview: A mysterious death of a young girl in the hills triggers a suspicious investigation that reveals the alleys of a high-profile organized crime in Kolkata, involving Drugs, sex-trafficking and murders.
title: Sin

overview: A story filled with laughter and tears revolving around an archaeologist who time travels to the Tang Dynasty and gets caught in the political struggles in the palace.
title: Tang Dynasty Tour

overview: Every weekend, two of the leading go to different cities in the world. According to the rules of the program, a master must live on Saturday and Sunday at $ 100 (for European countries - 70 euros or more), while the second can spend unlimited funds, which are stored on a gold card. To decide which of them will live like a millionaire, and who will study the survival of the leading travel before each flip a coin, and each time it is all Heads or tails.
title: Орел и решка

overview: Tansener Tanpura is a Bengali web series streaming on Bengali OTT platform hoichoi from 26th June 2020. The series starring Vikram Chatterjee, Rupsha Chatterjee, Jayati Bhatia, Rajat Ganguly in the lead roles. This thriller web series is about the clues to a treasure, hidden in melodies! Is the art in music the only solution to the mystery?
title: Tansener Tanpura

overview: Taranath Tantrik is a Bengali web series streaming on Bengali OTT platform hoichoi from 18th January 2018. In this series Taranath Tantrik as you experience the other-world with him. Directed by Q, the web-series promises horror like never before.
title: Taranath Tantrik

overview: This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.
title: The Aam Aadmi Family

overview: Moment of Truth is a five-part docuseries that tells the never-before-seen story behind the murder of beloved husband and father, James Jordan, and exposes the checked history in the small North Carolina town where the heinous crime and subsequent trial occurred.
title: Moment of Truth

overview: Take an unforgettable journey with Hillary Clinton and Chelsea Clinton as they go on adventures with some of the world's boldest and bravest women — from household names to unsung heroes — who make us laugh and inspire us to be more gutsy.
title: Gutsy

overview: For the first time, two great chefs will meet in the same culinary arena! Konstantin Ivlev and Renat Agzamov will assemble their teams of chefs to find the country's greatest culinary talent. Thousands of contenders, a rigorous selection process, but only one will emerge victorious in this culinary duel—the one who can impress the masters of haute cuisine with their dishes. The king of knives and the king of cakes—who will discover this unique talent?
title: Битва шефов

overview: Gorya is a simple girl who works at a flower shop. She passes an exam and gets accepted into a prestigious and luxurious school attended by the wealthy. The school is ruled by an elite clique known as the F4 consisting of four rich, handsome and spoiled boys. Gorya is the only one who stands up to their bullying, leaving all the boys in awe, especially Thyme, the group's leader. Almost instantly smitten by Gorya, Thyme romantically pursues her but she has no interest in him due to first impressions. She instead falls for his best friend Ren, However, Ren is still in love with his childhood love Mira. In all the chaos of school, Gorya can't help but find herself falling for Thyme because of his generosity to her and her family and his change of character.
title: F4 Thailand: Boys Over Flowers

overview: The series tells the story of "Ying Ying", an unpopular net idol who is about to seriously go down on her luck after being accidentally yet detrimentally caught a liar by her fans from a single video clip. She almost ends up with no more way to earn a living, so she tries all the ways to survive during the economic recession. Whenever she is about to start something new, her bad reputation haunts her like a life-long sin. Apart from helping herself to survive, she also needs to help her friend since "Ying Ying" is like a pillar of life for "Noina" who has been her best friend since they are young. Plus, she is now the creditor of Ying Ying who owns her debts. Their lives are encountering another change again when "Noina" meets her dream guy "Doctor Korn" who is flawlessly perfect with a handsome face and a great career life. An order from the heaven has been sent to "Noina" when she is whispered by a fortuneteller that she's definitely going to get married this year. Looking around, she finds "Doctor Korn" the one and only person who is suitable for her. The only problem is that in the next 46 days, "Doctor Korn" is going to get married to his well-known high-class girlfriend, "Wisa", a princess-like celebrity who treasures the numbers of views and her subscribers as much as the red blood cells that are nourishing her body. Both of them are better together! But it seems that this love can't be stopped because "Ying Ying" and "Noina" secretly find out that this fake bride - to - be is hiding a mystery behind. The mission to protect a good guy while setting him free from the devil-like bride to finally end up with an angel instead is ready to start. "Ying Ying's" bet is to be entirely free from all the debts she owns "Noina" without paying any money if the mission is successfully completed. However, there's not much time left while another obstacle, "Doctor Phat", Doctor Korn's close friend also shows up, suspiciously keeping his eyes on both girls in every move. Stay tuned to see whether this 46-day mission will successfully ruin the wedding in the end. Who is going to be caught lying!?
title: 46 Days

overview: X-Factor Ukraine is the Ukrainian version of The X Factor, a show originating from the United Kingdom. It is a television music talent show for aspiring pop singers drawn from public auditions. Auditions were held in major cities of Ukraine: Dnipropetrovsk, Lviv, Donetsk, Kharkiv, Kiev, Poltava, Luhansk, Zaporizhia, Simferopol, Mykolaiv, Chernivtsi, Uzhhorod, Lutsk, and Rivne.
title: X-Factor Ukraine

overview: The Julapakborirak loses the head of their family and Chairman of JPB Group, Tanapop, in a tragic plane crash. His oldest daughter, Metinee, miraculously survives the accident. Shortly after Tanapop passed away, Getsara, his wife and former secretary, is promoted to be a new chairman of the company. Metinee is not happy with the promotion because she believes that the plane crash was Getsara's plan to murder her father. Metinee asks her brothers, Wayu and Kampanart, to find the truth behind their father's death. However, the two brothers especially Wayu don't believe that Getsara had plotted the murder plan. Wayu's feeling for Getsara goes beyond a love between stepmother and son. Wayu decides to stay in Thailand to find the truth about the accident. Not long after Tanapop passed away, Passon – Getsara's ex-boyfriend, comes back to Getsara and asks her about the promise she had given to him. However, Getsara's feeling for him has already changed. So she tries to stay away from him. So Passon approaches Metinee to stir a conflict in the family and the JPB Group. He also sends his niece, Nuengjai, to work as Wayu's secretary to get inside information about the company. Passon finds out that Getsara and Wayu have developed a romantic feeling for each other. Passon is trying to get rid of Wayu from Getsara's life. How the love triangle, and the power struggle and revenge in the family will end?
title: An Eye for an Eye

overview: Be ready to get your heart refreshed and meet all the unstoppable funny moments in a comedy series Drag, I Love You. The story reveals a complicated love between a straight man and a straight woman that starts with ‘fake' feelings, both outside and inside, but as the situation is turned upside down, without realizing it, their love starts to blossom. Find out how much the story turns extraordinarily funny when a straight man and a straight woman have to turn themselves into Drag Queens to solve a complex investigation. Noo Na, a twin sister of Nadia, a top drag queen, is vying with Prab Seuk, a mischievous police officer who is assigned to investigate the case. They both need to search for the truth at the same place, Blueberry Rama. Chaotic, hot, and funny moments, together their love story begins. In the end, let's see whether these two fake drag queens can turn each other into real love.
title: Drag, I Love You

overview: A nerdy second-year dental student Pi falls in love with a kind-hearted fellow second-year Muang Nan from the Faculty of Allied Health Science; but he's too scared to confess. Muang Nan is like a "fish upon the sky", way too out of reach for someone as boring as him. That's why Pi asks his big brother Duean for some advice. After going through a major makeover with the help of his brother, the now cooler-than-ever Pi plucks up enough courage to approach Muang Nan. But a new problem arises when Mork, the hottest medical student, appears out of nowhere and seems to be aiming for Muang Nan, too. Discouraged and very much afraid, Pi once again turns to his big brother for help. But this time, Duean is caught up in a mess of his own when he can't shake an annoying freshman medical student Meen off his side. And so Pi must face this battle alone to win Muang Nan's love. But as the rivalry goes on, why does it feel as if Mork is hitting on him instead? Pi plunges into full confusion as his feelings for Mork start to change. What should he do with this feeling and will he ever dare to confess?
title: Fish Upon the Sky

overview: Annie, a former singer from the '90s is passed down from her uncle an agogo bar called Papa Gogo. She decides to renovate it and starts hunting down her agogo boys. The bar eventually becomes well-known as Mama Gogo. However, a local mafia boss Chen and Annie's frienemy, Tina who opens an agogo bar to compete with hers, always get in her way to success. Gather around and root for Annie! Let's see if the new mama can take control of the agogo kingdom.
title: Mama Gogo

overview: The series reveals the chaotic love story of "Kumarika", who has dreamed of becoming a teacher, but the first day of her life as a student teacher is totally a flop, and she even ends up in an argument with the heir of the school founder "Mom Rajawongse Nopphakhun", which makes Kumarika believe that he definitely dislikes her. As the story continues, it turns out that "Kumarika" makes his heart beat so fast once again after ages that he decides to win her heart, but their love life isn't as easy as expected. Nobody believes that a strikingly elegant millionaire like him will seriously fall for an ordinary woman who is just a daughter of a simple food store owner. Nonstop obstacles flood into their relationship, including the two wicked older brothers of ‘Kumarika' and the family of "Nopphakhun" who are ready to ruin their relationship all the time. Stay tuned to find out whether the love between these two social classes will be fulfilled in the end.
title: Mr. Lipstick

overview: 55:15 Never Too Late tells the story of five individuals whose lives are turned upside down when they turn 55. Instead of getting older, they find their lives restarting from the age of 15. Audiences will not want to miss the gripping chain of events that unfolds and the challenges the characters face as they return to their past to rectify bad life decisions.
title: 55:15 Never Too Late

overview: The series will bring a thrilling story of a woman who tragically loses her husband and has to take care not only of her family, but also wants to find out the truth about the murder of her husband, who was connected to the underworld. The main heroine decides to penetrate directly into the underworld.
title: Vdova

overview: Freshly transferred to the SRPJ in Strasbourg, police captain César Wagner is taking his place in his new team. Hardened bachelor, big-hearted cop, compulsive hypochondriac, obsessed by illness as much as by his job, César Wagner is not always in control of his life. And with good reason: three women occupy him and preoccupy him. Three women with whom he has to do everything: his mother, his fellow coroner, and his boss.
title: César Wagner

overview: STF agent Raghav goes on a secret mission to curtail the revival of a naxal uprising in Gadchiroli. But the war becomes too personal as he digs deeper and tries to uncover the larger plan of the uprising.
title: Naxalbari

overview: From the team behind Love My Way and The Secret Life of Us comes the Stan Original series Bump. The series centres around Oly, an ambitious and high-achieving teenage girl who has a surprise baby; and the complications that ensue for two families.
title: Bump

overview: Hatim, who is raised by the king and queen of Yemen, possesses unique powers and, later, finds himself fighting against the evil sorcerer, Zargam.
title: The Adventures of Hatim

overview: A global pandemic, a nation in lockdown, and a mysterious disappearance in the midst of it all! Sahil Gujral is gone. Did he fall prey to the virus? Or is something more sinister at play? 2020 has changed the world forever, but for the Gujral family, the nightmare has just begun!
title: The Gone Game

overview: After her sister and former manager Sirin disappeared mysteriously, Nabi takes it upon herself to investigate by becoming the beautiful manager of Dubai Club. The club belongs to Phichetchai, a man whom Nabi respects as someone she's indebted to. Phichetchai is a married man. He and his wife, Waree, have a son, Kawin. But because Phichetchai trusts Sirin so much, Waree gets the wrong idea and thinks they are having an affair. The jealousy is incited by none other than Waree's own sister, Weeranat, who is in love with Phichetchai and wants him for herself. Waree becomes a paranoid wife, and one day she dies of a mysterious cause. During the same time, Sirin also disappears without a trace. Waree's death brings her only son home from studying abroad. Kawin now seeks the truth about his mother's passing, whether it was accidental or elaborate. Kawin, who was sent abroad as soon as he finished high school, knew and loved Nabi even before they met at the club, and had asked to go out with her. But Nabi refused. What Kawin didn't know was that she turned him down, not because she didn't love him, but because he was Phichetchai's son. Once Kawin is back, he asks to train at his father's club. Phichetchai places Kawin under Nabi's supervision, and the two get to rekindle their feelings for each other. Nabi, still suppressing her feelings for Kawin, asks her best friend Pongpop to play lovers to push Kawin away. Pongpop agrees to help, but under the condition that Nabi also helps him win his first love and ex-girlfriend who is now a doctor, Sandee, back. At the same time, Kawin is investigating the death of his mother. Unfortunately, every evidence leads to Sirin, Nabi's sister, just according to Weeranat's plan. Now that Phichetchai seems to adore Nabi, Weeranat is getting paranoid that Nabi may be trying to steal everything from her. Meanwhile, Phichetchai has found out a secret about Weeranat, and her grief and resentment make her want to get rid of Phichetchai. Worse still, Kawin misunderstands Nabi's intention with his father and thinks she wants to become his stepmother. Will these misunderstandings resolve? How will their complicated relationships end: in love or in pain?
title: Nabi, My Stepdarling

overview: Weir is a young handsome baker who constantly has bakery customers and owners fighting over him. When he loses his job yet again because of his charm, he applies to work at Sweet Day, a new luxurious pastry shop owned by Punn, a troublemaker son of a top billionaire. Punn has a past that makes him unable to eat sweets. He only opens a bakery to surround himself with girl customers. Upon seeing Weir's profile, Punn hires him right away. But there's one big problem - Weir is scared of girls! Punn reluctantly hires Krathing, a former rising boxing star who has retired due to a medical condition, for help. Punn doesn't really like a nuisance like Krathing, but he has to give in because Krathing's great sense of taste for sweets is just what Weir is looking for. While Sweet Day starts attracting more customers, the shop faces bad reputation from news about a child's kidnapping. Apparently, the only evidence left by the kidnapper is a Sweet Day packaging. Famous online journalist Monetsnoops around the shop, as she believes the kidnapper is there. Monet finds a suspect wearing black sunglasses lurking in front of the shop, but he turns out to be Pooh, Punn's scary-looking but shy bodyguard who is there to keep watch and look after his young master. Later, Punn has no choice but to make Pooh his waiter to prevent any more misunderstanding. That's the beginning of their chaotic running of the bakery shop and mission to crack the case. They have to face many problems along the way, both work-related and matters of the heart. How will their messy relationship unfold? Tune in and root for them.
title: Baker Boys

overview: Enchanté is a French term that means "nice to meet you." But what is Theo supposed to do when four men claim to be the Enchanté he's looking for? Theo, a dashing young man who recently returned from France, is on a journey to find the real Enchanté with the assistance of his childhood friend Akk, who lives just across the street. The two of them are drawn by the mission to meet with these four ideal gentlemen: Natee, a third-year talented artist from the Faculty of Fine and Applied Arts. Phupha, a third-year academically outstanding student from the Faculty of Liberal Arts. Saifa, a third-year music genius from the Faculty of Communication Arts. And Wayo, a third-year football team captain from the Faculty of Sports Science. Who is going to be the final answer to this love? Hang tight and find out together.
title: Enchanté

overview: Onnapa is a mistress of a millionaire who owns the biggest flower business in the country. She has endured all kinds of mistreats by her husband's lawful life, Kannika, for years. When their husband dies, Kannika kicked Onnapa out of their home. Onnapa is enraged by the injustice and furious at Kannika. Although more than 30 years have passed, the resentment in Onnapa's heart has never eased off. Now, it is passed on to her daughter and grandchildren. Along with her daughter – Onsalao and her grandsons – Worakorn and Worawet, Onnapa comes back to take her revenge and reclaim things that should have been hers. Onnapa starts a war with Kannika and her descents including Kannika's daughter – Thantawan, and her grandchildren – Mintra, Nonsee, and Iris. Filled with trickery, deceit, and betrayal, how will this war end?
title: The War of Flowers

overview: Pat is a playful and mischievous boy while Pran is a tidy, prince-like perfectionist. Even before they were born, these two boys were destined to detest each other. Their parents each own a hardware business next door to each other, and they fiercely compete by lowering prices and stealing each other's employees. Their parents hate one another to the core, which is why the boys have been placed in a competition since they were newborns. The parents compare their children in every way conceivable, who crawls first, who walks first, or even who says mama and papa first. When the boys reach the age of 12, their wall begins to break. Pat's little sister, Pa, accidentally rides her bicycle into a pond in the village. While Pat is still in a state of fear, Pran suddenly jumps into the water and helps Pa up. The incident turns the relationship between the two boys into a change. On the surface, they still appear to be enemies, but they no longer truly despise each other. In their ninth grade, the boys are assigned to be in the same music band and they become closer. At this point, Pran's feeling towards Pat gradually develops. Four years later, fate plays a game with the two of them once more. Pat becomes the first-year class president of the Faculty of Engineering while Pran is also the class president of the Faculty of Architecture, and these two faculties happen to be all-time rivals. Pran and Pat are forced to battle once more. When Pa finds out, she demands Pat not to do Pran any harm because he was the one who saved her life at a young age. Pat decides to come to see Pran to propose an agreement. Pat suggests they exchange information about their groups in order to prevent both faculties from warring. Pran, who prefers not to argue, agrees to the idea and their "secret relationship" starts from there. They are neither buddies nor enemies, but they can certainly steal the hearts of the audience. When will this friendship that grows in the midst of conflicts come to an end? When will their secret be exposed? Will they be accepted by their parents? Will the conflicts get resolved eventually? Hang tight to find out.
title: Bad Buddy

overview: Rosie Jones is on a mission to help disabled people plan fun-filled British vacations.
title: Mission: Accessible

overview: Scotland's best-known outdoors man, Cameron McNeish, journeys up the western seaboard from the Mull of Kintyre to Mallaig. Travelling on foot, by bike, by pack-raft and with his beloved campervan, his journey takes him over 200 miles through some of our most impressive wild places. Along the way, he meets an artist, a storyteller and a ghillie. And most surprisingly of all he discovers how our ancestors created their music.
title: Roads Less Travelled: Atlantic Way

overview: In each episode, Mike transports himself back in time to some of the most major moments in history and connects the dots between these events - revealing incredible stories along the way. With his wry sense of humor and candid, no-nonsense take, Mike links society's most taken-for-granted moments to their surprising origins and connects them to the modern world of today. To help him out, he's roped in his pal Chuck who (reluctantly) acts out some of the historical events, demonstrating how everything in our wonderfully weird world came to be related.
title: Six Degrees with Mike Rowe

overview: Tony Award-winning actor James Monroe Iglehart will host Biggest Little Christmas Showdown—a four-part "mini-sized" holiday house tournament-style series. James will lead the nation's best miniaturists as they face-off to create the merriest mini holiday houses, complete with all the festive, tiny trimmings. Each week, only one team will wow the spirited panel of judges, including designer Genevieve Gorder and miniatures experts June Clinkscales and Dave Asling, to advance to the next round of this cheerful competition. In the final round, the top contenders will craft their most extravagant mini holiday houses ever for a chance at the ultimate victory: a grand prize worth $50,000 and the surprise of a lifetime when their winning miniature is super-sized into a magical vacation home decked out for the season.
